# Little Cookie Co.

Little Cookie Co. is a premium small-batch cookie business based in Arvada, Colorado.

## Core facts
- Service area: Arvada and select Denver ZIP codes
- Fulfillment: Pickup in Arvada and local delivery
- Lead time: Minimum 24 hours
- Core cookies: Chocolate Chip, Chocolate Chocolate, Peanut Butter, Oatmeal
- Seasonal cookies: Sugar Cookie, Salted Caramel

- Home: https://littlecookieco.com/
- Contact: https://littlecookieco.com/contact

- Privacy: https://littlecookieco.com/privacy
- Terms: https://littlecookieco.com/terms
